 initial["findings"].append(dict(id=f"N{i:02}", initial=condition, steps=steps, outcome=outcome, citation=citation(line), test=test, question=question))
supplement=dict(
 qualifications=[dict(id=id,status="qualified",rationale=rationale,citation=citation(line)) for id,line,rationale in data["qual"]],
 test_bindings=[dict(id=id,test=test,scope=scope) for id,test,scope in data["bindings"]])
for name,content in (("final.json",initial),("supplement.json",supplement)):
 (base/name).write_text(json.dumps(content,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
